notes:
Closure plant-finder 2: MARAD Small Shipyard Grant reconciliation, FY2023-FY2026 (retrieved 2026-11-13).
Sources (official maritime.dot.gov pages return 403, so trade-press reprints of the full lists were used and quoted): FY2023 (May 3, 2023, 27 awards) Marine Log reprint of the MARAD table; FY2024 (Jul 10, 2024, 15 awards) Marine Log reprint of the MARAD table; FY2025 (Jul 21, 2025, 17 awards) Marine Log 'complete list'; FY2026 (Aug 13, 2026, 45 awards) WorkBoat list. Professional Mariner reprints used for FY2023/FY2024 descriptions. Each list's parsed count equals its article's stated total. All 104 grant-row quotes verified against the fetched page text.
Counts: 104 award rows = 93 unique recipients (11 recipients appear in two years). Reconciled by script (tools: name tokens + state, with a stopword list, C&C-style token joining, fuzzy tokens gated on city, and >=2 tokens or 1 token + same city), then checked by eye: 42 resolved_to_existing, 1 new base, 34 excluded, 16 unverified (42+1+34+16 = 93). grant_reconciliation has one row per award (104): 46 resolved_to_existing, 1 new_base, 35 excluded, 22 unverified rows.
Matcher corrections made by hand: Steiner Construction -> p-steiner-construction-bayou-la-batre-al (not Steiner Shipyard); Master Boat Builders (FY2025, 'Bayou La Batre') and Eastern Shipbuilding Group (FY2025) are company-level awards naming no yard, so both ledger ids are recorded for each; ACBL Transportation Services (FY2023 Jeffersonville drydock 'for vessel repair, barge fleeting and cleaning') was NOT resolved to the closed Jeffboat record because the same site is not confirmed; it is a separate excluded record. Earlier false positives removed: Chesapeake Bay Maritime Museum (was matched to Chesapeake Shipbuilding) and Breaux's Bay Craft (was matched to Saronic on 'craft'). Rhodes Industries (FY2024 table spelling) = Rhoads Industries (p-rhoads-philadelphia-pa).
